content: {"summary":"Customers report that ride passes fail to appear in their account after purchase, causing frustration [#tk_1450182]. Many complain the app demands a code that never arrives, blocking login and purchase attempts [#tk_1976190]. Users also note missing purchase links in promotional emails, preventing them from buying passes at the announced times [#tk_1414626, #tk_1976514, #tk_1976510]. Additionally, some receive no notification of sale availability, leaving them unaware of purchase windows [#tk_57036, #tk_2000492]."}
